title: Listening Drill — Mounting a photograph
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Mounting a photograph
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about mounting a photograph for display. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the photo corners ready. Begin by checking the backing board. When everything is in position, wait five minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for level edges before moving on. don't put glue directly on the image. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
